incidents.title: Payment API elevated 500 errors
incidents.description: Payment API began returning HTTP 500 errors to checkout shortly after 10:00 UTC. Card authorisations are failing for a large share of requests.
incidents.impact_summary: ~28% of payment requests failing; checkout conversion down sharply for all regions.

incidents.title: Search results intermittently slow
incidents.description: A handful of customer reports say search occasionally feels slow. No alert has fired.
incidents.impact_summary: Unclear; no measurable error increase. Possibly a small latency regression.

incidents.title: Notification emails delayed
incidents.description: Order confirmation and password-reset emails are arriving 30+ minutes late.
incidents.impact_summary: Password resets effectively blocked for affected users; order confirmations delayed.

incidents.title: Checkout page 404s for static assets
incidents.description: CDN returned 404 for a new JS bundle for six minutes after a release.
incidents.impact_summary: Checkout page broken for ~6 minutes for users without cached assets.

incidents.title: Invoice PDF uploads failing
incidents.description: Customers cannot attach invoice PDFs; every upload returns an error. Started shortly after a document-service release.
incidents.impact_summary: All invoice uploads failing; uploads are piling up in the retry queue.

incidents.title: Order placement timing out
incidents.description: Placing an order hangs and then fails for most customers. The order database itself is up.
incidents.impact_summary: Most order placements failing for about eight minutes.

knowledge_documents.title: Runbook: payment-api database connectivity
knowledge_documents.body: When payment-api reports database connection timeouts: 1) Check DB connection pool utilization (in_use vs max) on payment-api pods. 2) Check database availability, CPU and active connections on payments-db. 3) Compare the effective max connection / pool size configuration with the last healthy deployment. 4) Review differences from the last healthy deployment before rolling back.

knowledge_documents.title: RCA: INC-0881 Payment API connection pool exhaustion
knowledge_documents.body: Impact: 41 minutes of elevated 500s on payment-api. Root cause: a configuration change reduced the database connection pool max from 100 to 10; under normal peak load requests queued for connections and timed out. Detection was delayed because the DB itself looked healthy. Resolution: validated config and restored the last-known-good pool size. Prevention: config schema validation for pool size, alert on pool saturation.

knowledge_documents.title: Runbook: notification-service SMTP delivery
knowledge_documents.body: If SMTP relay returns 421 rate limited: check sending volume vs provider quota, check whether a bulk campaign is running, enable the secondary relay, and pause non-critical email categories.

knowledge_documents.title: Guide: first 15 minutes of an incident
knowledge_documents.body: Establish impact, check recent deployments and config changes, look for matching past incidents, assign an incident commander, and communicate status every 15 minutes.

historical_incidents.title: Payment API connection pool exhaustion

historical_incidents.resolution: Validated config and restored last-known-good setting

historical_incidents.title: Payment API TLS certificate expired
historical_incidents.symptoms: Handshake failures to card processor; HTTP 502 errors
historical_incidents.root_cause: Expired client certificate for processor mTLS

historical_incidents.title: Email backlog after SMTP provider throttling
historical_incidents.symptoms: Email queue depth growing; SMTP 421 rate limited responses
historical_incidents.root_cause: Marketing bulk send exhausted shared SMTP quota
historical_incidents.resolution: Moved transactional email to a dedicated relay; paused bulk campaign

historical_incidents.title: Search latency during index rebuild
historical_incidents.symptoms: p95 latency doubled for 2 hours; no errors
historical_incidents.root_cause: Nightly index rebuild ran during business hours after cron timezone change
historical_incidents.resolution: Moved rebuild window; added rebuild-in-progress dashboard annotation
